uncited: The training procedure is divided into two distinct stages.
Stage 1 establishes the geometric and photometric foundation using 3DGS settings augmented with normal constraints.
- Optimized 3D Gaussian attributes: position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics coefficients (for view-dependent color), normal vectors, albedo, roughness, and environment map parameters.
The method operates on a set of 3D Gaussians.
**Rendering:** Render the scene from the input camera views using standard 3DGS alpha-blending.
**Rendering:** Render the scene using the PBR model, incorporating the sampled lighting and material properties.
- **Memory Complexity:** Memory usage scales with the number of Gaussians.
It builds upon the 3D Gaussian Splatting framework [26] and extends it with PBR capabilities.
